newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy to acquire Eselco.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy to acquire Eselco.

text.p: Eselco Inc. has agreed to be acquired by Wisconsin Energy Corp. in a stock deal valued at about $71 million, the companies said Wednesday.

Wisconsin Energy will offer $44.50 worth of its stock for each Eselco share in a tax-free reorganization. The number of shares issued will be determined by the price of Wisconsin Energy's stock over a certain period, they said.
Eselco's stock rose $1.50 to $36.50 early on Nasdaq. Wisconsin Energy edged up 25 cents to $25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Eselco, based in Saulte Ste. Marie, Mich., will pay Wisconsin Energy a fee of $2 million if it terminates the agreement to pursue a merger with a third party.
The companies said the deal is subject to the approval of Eselco shareholders and regulators. Eselco shareholders are expected to vote later this year, they said.
Eselco is the holding company for two electric utilities, Edison Sault Electric Co. and Northern Tree Service.
Wisconsin Energy has businesses in electricity, gas, steam and non-utility operations.
